h1: Content changes made when you ask
overview: Some store changes are small but take a long time to do yourself: a new sale banner, updated prices, new text on the home page, a swapped photo or a new menu link. Send us your list with the wording and images. We make each change in your store, check it on phone and desktop, and send you a screenshot. This order covers a set number of edits within the delivery time. A standing monthly arrangement is quoted separately.

faq: How do I send you my changes?
Use the order form to share a list, or a document with the new text, product names and photos. The clearer the list, the faster it is done, and we confirm anything unclear.
Can you write the new text for me?
We tidy and proof the text you give us. Writing new copy from scratch, such as product descriptions, is a separate service, and we can quote it with your list.
One change in one place, such as a new banner headline or a swapped image. A price change on a single product counts within the price update limit, and not as an edit.
Can I send more changes during the work?
You can add changes until we begin, and revisions are included after delivery. New requests during the work may need another order if they would pass the limit.
